items.name: Helms Row (Remada apoiada na ponta do banco com halteres)
items.highlighted_muscles: latíssimo do dorso, romboides, trapézio médio, bíceps
items.movement: Chest-supported dumbbell row: chest prone on 30-degree incline bench, feet floor, dumbbells from arms hanging vertically to elbows pulled back beside torso, torso stays supported.

items.name: Encolhimento de Ombros com Halteres Sentado
items.movement: Seated dumbbell shoulder shrug: upright on flat bench, arms fully straight at sides, shoulders elevate toward ears then lower, no elbow bend.

items.name: Encolhimento de Ombros no Banco Inclinado (Foco no trapézio médio/superior)
items.movement: Prone incline bench dumbbell shrug: chest supported on 30-degree bench, arms hanging straight, retract and elevate scapulae with tiny shoulder motion, elbows remain straight.

items.name: Agachamento com Halteres nas Laterais do Corpo
items.movement: Standing squat holding two dumbbells hanging at sides: feet shoulder width, bend knees and hips to thighs near horizontal, then stand, dumbbells remain beside legs.

items.name: Stiff no Smith
items.movement: Smith machine stiff-leg deadlift: bar in hands in front of thighs, locked to TWO vertical rails, hip hinge with slight fixed knee bend, bar descends to mid shin, flat spine, then stand.

items.name: Stiff com Pés Elevados na Rampa (Maior alongamento dos isquiotibiais)
items.movement: Stiff-leg deadlift with barbell standing on a low 10cm platform, both feet fully supported: slight fixed knee bend, hip hinge bar to shins then stand, neutral spine.

items.name: Hiperextensão Unilateral no Banco 45°
items.movement: Single-leg 45-degree back extension: one leg secured beneath ankle pad and thigh on angled support, other leg lifted slightly free. Hip hinge torso down then extend to straight line, no lumbar hyperextension.

items.name: Swing Russo com Kettlebell (Kettlebell Swing)
items.movement: Two-handed Russian kettlebell swing: side view, hip hinge kettlebell between thighs then hip extension swings bell only to chest height, arms straight, feet fixed.

items.name: Flexão de Joelho Deitado com Halter entre os Pés
items.movement: Prone dumbbell leg curl on flat bench: torso and thighs prone, one dumbbell securely held between BOTH feet, flex knees from almost straight to 90 degrees then lower, hips stationary.

items.name: Flexão de Joelho em Pé na Polia Baixa
items.movement: Standing single-leg cable hamstring curl: ankle cuff attached to LOW pulley behind working ankle; bend working knee bringing heel toward buttock, thigh vertical and hips fixed, hands support upright.

items.name: Flexão de Joelho em Pé com Caneleira
items.movement: Standing single-leg hamstring curl with ankle weight: hand on stable upright support, working thigh stays vertical, knee flexes heel toward buttock then lowers, ankle weight clearly visible.

items.name: Ponte de Isquiotibiais com Pernas Semi-estendidas (Long-Lever Glute Bridge)
items.movement: Long-lever glute bridge: lying supine on mat, heels planted farther from pelvis, knees only slightly bent, lift hips to shoulder-hip-heel line then lower, arms on floor.

items.name: Kas Glute Bridge (Elevação Pélvica com amplitude curta no topo)
items.movement: Kas glute bridge: upper back on low bench, barbell with thick pad across pelvis, feet flat, knees near90, short hip motion only in upper third of bridge, bench and feet fixed.

items.name: Step-up Alto na Caixa (Tronco inclinado à frente)
items.movement: High box step-up with slight forward torso lean: one foot planted on knee-high box, drive through that leg to stand on box, other foot rises free, then lower to initial floor position. Box fixed.

items.name: Extensão de Quadril em 4 Apoios com Caneleira (Perna estendida)
items.movement: Quadruped straight-leg hip extension wearing ankle weight: hands under shoulders, support knee under hip, working knee straight, lift working leg from toe near floor to horizontal, neutral spine.

items.name: Hidrante (Fire Hydrant - Abdução em 4 apoios com caneleira ou elástico)
items.movement: Quadruped fire hydrant with ankle weight: working knee held90degrees, lift bent thigh sideways away from body then return, pelvis level and arms stable.

items.name: Queda Pélvica Lateral no Step (Hip Drop / Pelvic Drop)
items.movement: Lateral pelvic drop: stand one straight leg on edge of low step, other leg hangs off side; lower unsupported side of pelvis slightly then lift it back level, supporting knee remains straight, hand rail.

items.name: Deslizamento Lateral de Adutores no Solo (Slider Lateral Lunge)
items.movement: Slider lateral lunge: one foot on round slider moves sideways across floor while support leg knee bends, torso hinges slightly, return sliding foot inward to standing, feet face forward.

items.name: Elevação Lateral Deitado de Lado no Banco Inclinado
items.movement: Side-lying dumbbell lateral raise on incline bench: athlete lies on left side against30degree bench, right arm lifts dumbbell from near right hip outward to shoulder level, elbow slightly bent fixed.

items.name: Rosca Unilateral na Polia Baixa (De frente)
items.movement: Standing unilateral low cable biceps curl facing pulley. Right hand holds single D handle, cable from low pulley in FRONT, right elbow pinned at ribs, upper arm vertical, flex elbow from almost straight to hand near shoulder, then lower. Left arm relaxed. Fixed feet and neutral torso.

items.name: Elevação Lateral Completa (Lu Raise - subindo até acima da cabeça)
items.movement: Lu raise with two light dumbbells: standing, straight arms raise laterally from sides through horizontal all way overhead, rotate palms forward near top, then lower via sides.

items.name: Elevação Lateral Parcial Pesada (Heavy Partial Lateral Raise)
items.movement: Heavy partial dumbbell lateral raise: standing, dumbbells at sides, lift only lower30degree arc, elbows slightly bent fixed, no shrug or overhead motion.

items.name: Elevação Frontal com Halteres em Pegada Neutra (Martelo)
items.movement: Neutral-grip dumbbell front raise: standing, two dumbbells held thumbs-up, straight arms lift FORWARD to shoulder height then lower, side three-quarter camera shows sagittal movement.

items.name: Crucifixo Inverso no Banco Inclinado com Halteres
items.movement: Prone incline bench dumbbell reverse fly: chest on30degree bench, arms hang with palms facing, open both arms wide until aligned with shoulders, fixed slight elbow bend, rear deltoids orange.

items.name: Rotação Externa de Ombro com Halter (Deitado de lado ou apoiado no joelho)
items.movement: Side-lying dumbbell external shoulder rotation: lying on left side on flat bench, right elbow tucked to rib cage bent90degrees, rotate right forearm from abdomen to pointing upward, upper arm and elbow fixed at side.
